title: My day
blurb: Studying maths in Copenhagen, working, running.

paragraphs.zh: 我叫米格，我是丹麦人。我住在哥本哈根。
paragraphs.en: My name is 米格, and I'm Danish. I live in Copenhagen.

paragraphs.zh: 我在大学学习数学。我也在一家保险公司工作。
paragraphs.en: I study mathematics at university. I also work at an insurance company.

paragraphs.zh: 我每天早上八点去大学。下午我去公司上班。我的工作很有意思，可是我常常很忙。
paragraphs.en: Every morning at eight I go to the university. In the afternoon I go to work at the company. My job is interesting, but I'm often busy.

paragraphs.zh: 晚上我很累。可是我很喜欢跑步，也喜欢玩电脑。
paragraphs.en: In the evening I'm tired. But I love running, and I like playing on the computer too.

paragraphs.zh: 我的女朋友是中国人。我想和她的家人说中文，我每天学一点。
paragraphs.en: My girlfriend is Chinese. I want to speak Chinese with her family, so I learn a little every day.
